ExampleDefinition.ToolTipDescription: Demonstrates a real-time animated Scattered Vector Field chart with particles advected through three Rankine vortices, using NonUniformVectorFieldDataSeries.
ExampleDefinition.Description:
This example demonstrates a real-time [b]Scattered (Non-Uniform) Vector Field Chart[/b] - a set of particles at arbitrary positions, each showing its local flow velocity as an arrow, animated at up to ~50 fps.
The chart uses [b]VectorFieldRenderableSeries[/b] and [b]NonUniformVectorFieldDataSeries[/b], which stores flat (X, Y, DX, DY) tuples for scatter-positioned vectors. Three [b]Rankine vortices[/b] (regularised point vortices) define the steady flow field. Each frame, every particle is advected to a new position using an [b]explicit Euler integration[/b] step, its velocity is re-sampled at the new position, and the particle wraps around the domain boundary if it leaves.
Thread safety is maintained with a [b]double-buffer[/b]: the background timer writes updated positions and velocities into scratch arrays, and the UI rendering handler copies them into the live arrays that the DataSeries wraps before calling InvalidateParentSurface.
Two update modes are available via the toolbar: - [b]Normal[/b] - a background thread-pool timer fires every 20 ms (~50 fps); the rendering handler invalidates the chart only when new data is ready. - [b]Performance[/b] - the data update runs directly inside CompositionTarget.Rendering every frame for maximum throughput, with a FPS overlay shown.
[b]Features demonstrated[/b]
- NonUniformVectorFieldDataSeries with scattered, time-varying particle positions - Real-time update of both X/Y positions and DX/DY vectors via double-buffered arrays - Scalable particle count via toolbar slider (re-initialises on next Start) - Color mapping by magnitude or by direction via HeatmapColorPalette - Two built-in colour map presets: Plasma and Cool-Warm - Three arrow length modes: DataUnits, MagnitudePixels, FixedPixels - Normal and Performance update modes with optional FPS overlay
